newsitem.title: UK: LME copper edges higher in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper edges higher in late trading.

text.p: Copper prices maintained a firmer tone in late trading on Thursday following a constructive kerb close.
Three months metal was quoted at $2,292/$2,294 per tonne at 1800 GMT, compared to $2,280 at the end of the afternoon session.
Cash to threes backwardation meanwhile was little changed at $137/$147.
Prices had rebounded on short covering after sinking to five-month lows in early trading. But traders said on the upside copper would meet initial resistance at $2,300.
Other metals were little different from the kerb close. Aluminium was indicated virtually unchanged at $1,580/$1,583 while zinc was a few dollars firmer at $1,515/$1,518.
